name: ai-phone-answering-system (VoxLane)
description: VoxLane — a real-time AI voice receptionist SaaS. A NestJS backend (port 3003) handles Telnyx telephony webhooks, business logic, and tool/booking calls; a Go voice-gateway (port 8080) holds the WebSocket media stream, decodes Telnyx audio, runs the OpenAI Realtime voice model with Cartesia TTS, and bridges caller audio to the model. Deployed on a single Ubuntu VPS at srv1194478:/opt/ai-voice-receptionist, fronted by Caddy, with Redis for session state and BullMQ for async jobs.
readmeHead: No README.md present. The project uses VoxLane_Implementation_Blueprint.md and a series of dated handoff/session notes (docs/ + *.md at root) as primary documentation.
